senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;cmp. שָׁלַל I , a. Arab. savila) [that which hangs on, attachment,];du. שׁוּלַיִם, pl. שׁוּלִים

units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 829:1">Yalk. Deut. 829</cite> <he>פעמונים … שׁוּלֵי המעיל</he> the bells which the high priest wore on the skirts of his cloak.

senses.gloss: lower part of the body, abdomen, buttock; contrad. to פה. Ohol. XI, 7 שהטומאה … שׁוּלָיו for the uncleanness (which the animal swallowed before it died) is assumed to take its way by its abdomen (and not through its mouth).
rim at the bottom of a vessel, saucer attached to the vessel; in gen. the bottom, rest of a vessel.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 30:1">Kel. XXX, 1</cite> <he>שולי קערה וכ׳</he> the lower part of a (broken) vesssel or of a salver of glass, which one made available for use.

<cite ref="Shabbat 30a:7">Sabb. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>נהפכו פני … כשולי קדרה</he> the faces of David’s enemies turned (black) like the bottom of a pot; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:4">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00706"><he>שָׁחַר</he> II</cite>. Ohol. IX, 13 <he>היתה עומדת על שׁוּלֶיהָ והיא כלי</he> if the vessel stands on its rest, and it is available as a vessel (not defective). Tosef. ib. X, 3 <he>היו שׁוּלָיו חדין וכ׳</he> if its rim at the bottom is sharp (not rounded), and there is not a handbreadth between its rim and the ground. Ib. 2 <he>עמוד … שוליה של זו על פיה וכ׳</he> a column of pots …, the bottom of one on the mouth of the other &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 7:2">Dem. VII, 2</cite> <he>מה … בשולי הכוס</he> what I intend to leave (of the wine) at the bottom of the cup; a. v. fr.
